All 14 tests pass.

🟢 Green Phase Complete:

**Implementation**: In `/home/experimenter/experiments/runs/2026-07-26_09-57-57_claim-office-example-mapping_v4-exact-subagents_opus-5-no-thinking/src/claim-office.ts`, `quote` now groups items by type (`groupByType`) and sums each group's base premium. A group priced as a block when its size is exactly 3, otherwise per-item.

**Result**: All tests now pass (14 passing, 41 todo)

**Approach**: This is minimal because the prior code already had the "exactly 3 of the same type → 60G" rule; the only thing the new test demanded was applying that rule per type-group rather than to the whole list. `formsComponentBlock` shed its `every(same type)` check since grouping now guarantees homogeneity — no new pricing logic was added. Remainder handling (e.g. 4 runes → one block + 1 leftover) is deliberately *not* implemented, since the existing green tests pin 4 runes at 100 and 7 runes at 175.

Proceeding to Refactor phase.
